description: Dates for a meeting, answered by everybody it is put to. The board's owner calls meetings and puts up times; everyone else says which ones work for them — none, one or all of them. Who is answering is the caller the server verified, and whether they may organise is the role it states, never a field of the request — so deployed and shared with a team, every member answers as themselves and nobody but the owner sets the poll up. That the organiser puts up the dates, that a closed poll takes nothing more, and that a person answers a date once are the database's to enforce, so it refuses what the page would not have offered, and says why. Needs an hkp-node kept under the name `node`.

state.schema:
-- Who is who: an address, and what the board's member list called it the
-- last time they came by. Everybody else is shown the name, never the address.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS person (
  email TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name  TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS poll (
  name      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  -- The address of whoever called it. Only the board's owner may, so a call
  -- by anybody else arrives naming nobody, and is refused below.
  organiser TEXT,
  closed    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS option (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  poll       TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- Who put the date up: what the trigger below checks it against.
  proposedBy TEXT,
  starts     TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT a_date_and_a_time
             CHECK (starts GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9] [0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]')
);
-- A date is on the poll once, however often it is put up.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS one_option_per_time
  ON option (poll, starts);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vote (
  id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  option INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES option (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  -- The address of whoever answered, as the server that signed them in said.
  voter  TEXT NOT NULL,
  castAt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
-- One person, one answer per date: a second tap cannot count twice.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS one_vote_per_option
  ON vote (option, voter);
-- The rules a WHERE clause would only decline to break. Said here they are
-- refused with a reason, which is what the board has to show a person.
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS the_owner_calls_the_meetings
BEFORE INSERT ON poll
WHEN NEW.organiser IS NULL
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'only the board''s owner can call a meeting');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS a_date_is_for_a_meeting
BEFORE INSERT ON option
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poll WHERE name = NEW.poll)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'there is no meeting to put a date up for');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS the_organiser_puts_up_the_dates
BEFORE INSERT ON option
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poll WHERE name = NEW.poll)
 AND NEW.proposedBy IS NOT (SELECT organiser FROM poll WHERE name = NEW.poll)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'only the person who called the meeting can put up a date');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS a_closed_poll_takes_no_dates
BEFORE INSERT ON option
WHEN (SELECT closed FROM poll WHERE name = NEW.poll) = 1
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the poll is closed');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS a_closed_poll_takes_no_answers
BEFORE INSERT ON vote
WHEN (SELECT p.closed FROM poll p JOIN option o ON o.poll = p.name
       WHERE o.id = NEW.option) = 1
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the poll is closed');
END;
state.statement:
INSERT INTO person (email, name)
SELECT $caller_email, $caller_name
 WHERE coalesce($caller_email, '') <> ''
-- A name is the member list's, and only a shared board has one: opened
-- anywhere else, the name it gave last time stands.
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = coalesce(excluded.name, person.name)

INSERT INTO poll (name, organiser)
SELECT trim($poll),
       -- The owner calls the meetings. Anybody else's call names nobody,
       -- which the schema refuses with its reason.
       CASE WHEN $caller_role = 'owner' THEN $caller_email END
 WHERE $intent = 'create'
   AND trim($poll) <> ''
   AND coalesce($caller_email, '') <> ''
   -- Calling a meeting that is already there opens it.
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poll WHERE name = trim($poll))

INSERT INTO option (poll, proposedBy, starts)
-- A date picker says '2026-09-24T14:00'; the poll keeps it with a space.
SELECT trim($poll), $caller_email, replace(trim($starts), 'T', ' ')
 WHERE $intent = 'propose'

DELETE FROM option
 WHERE $intent = 'withdraw'
   AND id = $option
   AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM poll p
      WHERE p.name = option.poll AND p.organiser = $caller_email AND p.closed = 0
   )

INSERT INTO vote (option, voter)
SELECT $option, $caller_email
 WHERE $intent = 'vote'
   AND coalesce($caller_email, '') <> ''

DELETE FROM vote
 WHERE $intent = 'unvote'
   AND option = $option
   AND voter  = $caller_email
   AND NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM option o JOIN poll p ON p.name = o.poll
      WHERE o.id = $option AND p.closed = 1
   )

UPDATE poll
   SET closed = CASE $intent WHEN 'close' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
 WHERE $intent IN ('close', 'reopen')
   AND name      = $poll
   AND organiser = $caller_email

WITH
  shown(name) AS (
    -- The meeting asked for, or else the one called last: somebody opening the
    -- board has asked for nothing yet.
    SELECT coalesce(
      (SELECT name FROM poll WHERE name = trim(coalesce($poll, ''))),
      (SELECT name FROM poll ORDER BY created DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1)
    )
  ),
  me(email) AS (SELECT coalesce($caller_email, '')),
  meeting AS (
    SELECT p.organiser AS organiser, p.closed AS closed
      FROM poll p JOIN shown ON p.name = shown.name
  ),
  answers AS (
    SELECT o.id     AS id,
           o.starts AS starts,
           count(v.id) AS yes,
           max(CASE WHEN v.voter = me.email THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mine,
           group_concat(
             CASE
               WHEN v.voter IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN v.voter = me.email THEN 'you'
               -- Everybody else by the name the member list gave them, never
               -- by their address.
               ELSE coalesce(
                 nullif(who.name, ''),
                 CASE WHEN v.voter = m.organiser THEN 'the organiser' ELSE 'a member' END
               )
             END, ', ') AS voters
      FROM shown
      JOIN option o ON o.poll = shown.name
      CROSS JOIN me
      LEFT JOIN meeting m ON 1 = 1
      LEFT JOIN vote v ON v.option = o.id
      LEFT JOIN person who ON who.email = v.voter
     GROUP BY o.id, o.starts
  ),
  best(n) AS (SELECT coalesce(max(yes), 0) FROM answers)
SELECT
  a.id     AS id,
  -- The meeting each date belongs to, so that answering it keeps whoever
  -- answers on that meeting even after a newer one is called.
  shown.name AS poll,
  a.starts AS starts,
  a.yes    AS yes,
  a.mine   AS mine,
  CASE strftime('%w', substr(a.starts, 1, 10))
    WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue'
    WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri'
    ELSE 'Sat'
  END || ' ' || substr(a.starts, 1, 10) || ' at ' || substr(a.starts, 12, 5) AS label,
  CASE WHEN a.yes = 0 THEN 'Nobody yet' ELSE a.voters END AS who,
  CASE
    WHEN a.yes = best.n AND best.n > 0 THEN a.yes || ' yes - best so far'
    ELSE a.yes || ' yes'
  END AS score,
  CASE WHEN a.mine = 1 THEN 'unvote' ELSE 'vote' END AS intent,
  CASE WHEN a.mine = 1 THEN 'Take it back' ELSE 'Works for me' END AS answerLabel,
  CASE WHEN m.closed = 1 OR me.email = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS locked
FROM answers a
CROSS JOIN shown
CROSS JOIN best
CROSS JOIN me
LEFT JOIN meeting m ON 1 = 1
ORDER BY a.starts

WITH
  shown(name) AS (
    -- The meeting asked for, or else the one called last: somebody opening the
    -- board has asked for nothing yet.
    SELECT coalesce(
      (SELECT name FROM poll WHERE name = trim(coalesce($poll, ''))),
      (SELECT name FROM poll ORDER BY created DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1)
    )
  ),
  me(email) AS (SELECT coalesce($caller_email, ''))
SELECT
  coalesce(p.name, '') AS name,
  CASE WHEN p.name IS NULL THEN ''
    ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM option o WHERE o.poll = p.name) || ' dates · '
      || (SELECT count(DISTINCT v.voter)
            FROM vote v JOIN option o ON o.id = v.option
           WHERE o.poll = p.name) || ' answered'
  END AS progress,
  CASE
    WHEN p.name IS NULL AND $caller_role = 'owner'
      THEN 'No meeting yet. Call one on Organise, and everybody the board is shared with can answer it.'
    WHEN p.name IS NULL
      THEN 'Nothing to answer yet: no meeting has been called.'
    WHEN p.organiser = me.email AND p.closed = 1
      THEN 'You closed this poll. The answers stand as they are.'
    WHEN p.organiser = me.email
      THEN 'You called this meeting, so you put up the dates and you close the poll.'
    WHEN p.closed = 1
      THEN 'Closed by ' || coalesce(nullif(org.name, ''), 'the board''s owner') || '. The answers stand as they are.'
    ELSE 'Called by ' || coalesce(nullif(org.name, ''), 'the board''s owner') || ', who puts up the dates. Answer the ones that work for you.'
  END AS notice
FROM shown
CROSS JOIN me
LEFT JOIN poll p ON p.name = shown.name
LEFT JOIN person org ON org.email = p.organiser

WITH
  shown(name) AS (
    -- The meeting asked for, or else the one called last: somebody opening the
    -- board has asked for nothing yet.
    SELECT coalesce(
      (SELECT name FROM poll WHERE name = trim(coalesce($poll, ''))),
      (SELECT name FROM poll ORDER BY created DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1)
    )
  )
-- One row for the board's owner and none for anybody else, so what the
-- facade draws from it is there only for the one who may use it.
SELECT
  coalesce(p.name, '') AS name,
  CASE
    WHEN p.name IS NULL THEN 'No meeting yet: call one below.'
    ELSE 'Organising ' || p.name || CASE WHEN p.closed = 1 THEN ' (closed)' ELSE '' END
  END AS heading,
  CASE WHEN p.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS nothingToClose,
  CASE WHEN p.closed = 1 THEN 'Reopen the poll' ELSE 'Close the poll' END AS closeLabel,
  CASE WHEN p.closed = 1 THEN 'reopen' ELSE 'close' END AS closeIntent,
  CASE
    WHEN p.closed = 1 THEN 'Let people answer ' || p.name || ' again?'
    ELSE 'Close voting on ' || coalesce(p.name, '') || '?'
  END AS closePrompt,
  CASE WHEN p.name IS NULL THEN 'Put up a date' ELSE 'Put up a date for ' || p.name END AS proposeLabel
FROM shown
LEFT JOIN poll p ON p.name = shown.name AND p.organiser = $caller_email
WHERE $caller_role = 'owner'

WITH
  shown(name) AS (
    -- The meeting asked for, or else the one called last: somebody opening the
    -- board has asked for nothing yet.
    SELECT coalesce(
      (SELECT name FROM poll WHERE name = trim(coalesce($poll, ''))),
      (SELECT name FROM poll ORDER BY created DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1)
    )
  )
SELECT
  o.id     AS id,
  p.name   AS poll,
  CASE strftime('%w', substr(o.starts, 1, 10))
    WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue'
    WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri'
    ELSE 'Sat'
  END || ' ' || substr(o.starts, 1, 10) || ' at ' || substr(o.starts, 12, 5) AS label,
  p.closed AS locked,
  'Take ' || o.starts || ' off the poll, along with every answer given to it?' AS dropPrompt
FROM shown
JOIN poll p   ON p.name = shown.name AND p.organiser = $caller_email
JOIN option o ON o.poll = p.name
WHERE $caller_role = 'owner'
ORDER BY o.starts

WITH
  shown(name) AS (
    -- The meeting asked for, or else the one called last: somebody opening the
    -- board has asked for nothing yet.
    SELECT coalesce(
      (SELECT name FROM poll WHERE name = trim(coalesce($poll, ''))),
      (SELECT name FROM poll ORDER BY created DESC, rowid DESC LIMIT 1)
    )
  )
SELECT
  p.name AS name,
  CASE WHEN p.name = shown.name THEN '• ' ELSE '' END
    || p.name
    || CASE WHEN p.closed = 1 THEN ' (closed)' ELSE '' END AS label
FROM poll p
CROSS JOIN shown
ORDER BY p.created DESC, p.rowid DESC

items.placeholder: Answer every date that works for you — none, one or all of them. Everybody the board is shared with answers the same poll, each as themselves.
Calling a meeting, putting up its dates and closing it are the board owner's. Everybody else answers on Vote. Pick the meeting to work on, or call a new one.
